name: PlugAbandonmentLiabilityTracker
tagline: Every idle well, its P&A deadline, liability and bond cover – and the campaign that will plug it.
description: A complete plug and abandonment app for Power Apps and Power Pages: liability dashboard with contingency, 12-month deadline runway, drag-and-drop campaign sequencing with projected rig slots and late flags, bond coverage and shortfall, and a well register with the P&A status workflow, regulator actions (NOI, extensions, non-compliance, completion reports), bulk actions and CSV export. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen.
features: Liability with contingency and default-cost flag
Derived deadlines from the inactive date
Projected rig slots with late-slot flags
Sequence by deadline and apply slot dates
Blanket and individual bond coverage and shortfall
P&A status workflow with required fields per status
11 quick filters, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard field control PlugAbandonmentLiabilityTrackerPortal for Power Pages
